metaTitle: Custom Heat Transfer Apparel | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom heat transfer apparel in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Durable, vibrant designs for teams and events.
introHtml: Heat transfer decoration gives you the ability to add detailed, full-color artwork to a wide range of garments, from performance polos to down jackets. The process applies a flexible, durable print that withstands regular wear and washing, making it a smart choice for employee uniforms, event giveaways, or team gear. Whether you are branding Nike hooded jackets or OGIO quarter-zips, heat transfer delivers crisp logos and gradients without heavy minimums or setup fees.
heroAltText: Custom heat transfer apparel featuring a full-color logo on a performance polo, ideal for bulk orders
